A friend of Muriel's tried to escape from the Plains of Havoc, but did not make it out alive. His body is half-hidden by a tree, west of the camp of cyclopes, orcs and minotaurs. Open it to receive an {item:Iron Helmet}, a {item:Sudden Death Rune}, a {item:Leather Armor}, the book {item:Porgol's Strange Behaviour (Book)|Porgol's Strange Behaviour}, some {item:Worn Leather Boots} and a {item:Longsword}.
A friend of Muriel tried to escape from the Plains of Havoc, but could not get out of there alive.
Body next to the tree, Plains of Havoc

There are normally no creatures next to the body, but the camp beside it has {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}, {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}, {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages} and {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}: do not get too close.
Get to the Plains of Havoc

The {wiki:Plains of Havoc} are in the south of the continent, **southwest of Venore** and southeast of Kazordoon ({coord:32747,32258,7}). Leave from **Venore** and go on foot **southwest** to the plains. No boat or special equipment is needed.

Once in the **Plains of Havoc**, look for the camp of {creature:Cyclops|Cyclopes}, {creature:Orc|Orcs} and {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}. The body is right **west** of that camp, partly hidden by a tree.
Near the tree there are usually lots of {item:Leather Armor|Leather Armors}, {item:Letter|Letters} and {item:Worn Leather Boots} scattered on the ground: it is a sign you are in the right place.
Open the body and take the rewards.
To leave, go back on foot the same way to the **northeast**, to **Venore**. If you need to rest first, the Plains of Havoc have a temple (the one with {npc:Oldrak}).
